title: Pascal's law (প্যাসকেলের সূত্র)
placement: Book page 141, topic 5.3.3 (প্যাসকেলের সূত্র, starting on p140): next to the box with the law ('একটা আবদ্ধ পাত্রে তরল বা বায়বীয় পদার্থে বাইরে থেকে চাপ দেওয়া হলে …'), the paragraph 'প্যাসকেলের সূত্রের ব্যবহার' with P = F₁/A₁ and F₂ = PA₂ = F₁(A₂/A₁), and চিত্র ৫.০৫ (two cylinders joined by a pipe: F₁ on the small piston, F₂ on the big one).
description: Pascal's law (page 141, topic 5.3.3) as a hydraulic car lift in a colourful workshop (a deep teal wall with an orange band, a pegboard of tools, a red tool chest, tyres, a blue oil drum, a blue-grey epoxy floor with yellow safety lines). The lift is cut open along its middle so the golden oil shows: a small pump cylinder (A₁ = 0.01 m²) with a chrome T-handle, a pipe along the floor, and a wide lift cylinder whose ram carries a platform with a yellow car (weight W = 8,000 N). The student picks the lift cylinder in the row of words (A₂ = 10, 50 or 100 × A₁, the book's example being 100) and the push on the handle F₁ with a stepper (50 to 300 N); the formula P = F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂ and the sums P = F₁/A₁, F₂ = F₁(A₂/A₁) and F₂ against W update live, each symbol a button that makes its arrow or area pulse. One tap pushes the handle down 10 cm: bold outlined arrows show F₁ down on the handle, F₂ up on the ram and W down on the car; equal red arrows (in a white outline) square to every wall, the pipe and both pistons show the same pressure everywhere; teal bars mark A₁ and A₂. If F₂ is more than W the car rises d₂ = d₁(A₁/A₂) (1 mm for 100 ×), else the handle does not move. The first time, the camera goes close to the oil (all the red arrows equal) and then to a millimetre scale on the lift cylinder where the tiny rise shows, then back. The next taps push the handle 100 times (sped up, said in the result line): the car rises a little each time, up to 25 cm, then the action lowers it. The rule grows in the book's words: the law in its box; pressure equal so F₂ = F₁(A₂/A₁); বলবৃদ্ধিকরণ নীতি, শক্তি নয় with F₁d₁ = F₂d₂ in joules; কলকারখানা কিংবা বিমান নিয়ন্ত্রণে. Test tab: 5 questions (F₂ from F₁ and the pistons on the picture; how far the car rises for a push; the pressure under the big piston; the direction of the oil's pressure on the walls; the energy out), every wrong choice a real mistake with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
